name: Buzzbox 525
summary: Along Darkshore’s coast, Buzzbox 525 waits for the last of Wizbang Cranktoggle’s strange requests. The gnome’s scattered machines call for animal remnants and ever stranger materials.

sections.title: A Slurred Transmission
sections.body: After Buzzbox 323 is serviced, its rattling speakers carry Wizbang Cranktoggle’s garbled instructions. His words slur through drunken chuckles and rambling directions, sending his helpers far south along Darkshore’s main road. He asks them to hunt grizzled thistle bears and place four thick scalps in Buzzbox 525’s compartment. The machine is concealed behind a fence in the brush beside the road.

sections.title: The Distiller's Secret
sections.body: Wizbang Cranktoggle’s voice comes from Buzzbox 525, where raucous singing drowns the hum of the machinery. When the grizzled bear scalps go into the receptacle, Wizbang admits what his machines are for. His contraptions carry messages, but they also brew and distill liquor. Night elves do not welcome his trade in their towns, so he hid the machines in the wilds. The bear scalps feed the brewing of potent thistle bear beer.

faq.answer: Buzzbox 525 lies far south along the main road from Auberdine, just off the path near a rustic fence, partly hidden beneath bushes.

faq.q: Why does Wizbang want grizzled scalps?
faq.answer: Wizbang says the grizzled scalps are needed to repair Buzzbox 525, as earlier machines needed crawler legs, thresher eyes, and moonstalker fangs. A drunken song about thistle bear beer suggests another use for them.

faq.q: Why does Wizbang hide the Buzzboxes out in the wilderness?
faq.answer: Wizbang placed the machines outside Auberdine and depends on travelers to reach them. Buzzbox 525 reveals that he hid them because night elves do not welcome his liquor trade in their towns.

faq.q: Who is speaking through the Buzzbox?
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle, an enterprising gnome tinkerer, speaks through the voice transmitters he installed in his Buzzboxes across Darkshore.

faq.q: Can Wizbang speak through the machine without the scalps?
faq.answer: Yes. Wizbang speaks through Buzzbox 525 before the scalps are added. He explains why he asked for them once the work is done.

faq.q: What song does the Buzzbox sing?
faq.answer: Before you add the scalps, the speaker repeats a drunken limerick: “Though crawler wine's sweet, and thresher ale fine, and moonstalker moonshine is grand. There's nothing so dear, as a thistle bear beer, and soon I shall have some on hand!”

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Darkshore’s strict stewardship leaves little patience for reckless gnomish tinkering.
As a gnome, you can recognize Wizbang’s ambition in machines that mix complex engineering with questionable practical priorities.
